description: Sanitized samples behind docs/performance.md. rows: the first comparison (values rounded to 6 significant digits; medians/ranges from unrounded values; negative medianTimeChangePercent means less time). qualification: the matched rerun.

sampleKinds.operation-row: One logged operation interval per value.
sampleKinds.logged-batch-average: Each value is one logged average over the fixture's internal repetitions.
sampleKinds.logged-run-summary-without-internal-raw-: Each value is one logged per-process median/p50; internal raw samples were not emitted and cannot be recovered.
sampleKinds.instrumentation-or-scalar: Deterministic count or byte total; not a latency.
sampleKinds.whole-build-or-pack-operation: Whole build or pack wall time per run.

candidate.description: First-comparison candidate: uncommitted performance-branch tree on the same baseline, before the prompt-cache accounting change. Measured file map of 123 frozen SHA-256 hashes, including changed files and shared lock/catalog inputs; deletions are not listed.

environment.lane: Serial task-owned runs, fresh Node processes, warm filesystem, shared non-idle workstation. No sample discarded.

fixtures: Original research fixtures identified by content hash in scripts/performance/provenance.json.

idNotes.primitive/*: Same-process alternating trials against copied baseline TUI sources (editor/input/wrap).
idNotes.background-1000: listBackgroundCommands over 1,000 completed job directories (job listing control).
idNotes.background-monitor: Acknowledged-job monitor boundary scans for 1,000 terminal jobs.
idNotes.spill-64mib: Synchronous OutputAccumulator spill; not the Bash tool or its native producer.
idNotes.build/1|build/2|build/4: Clean ten-package build with a ready queue of 1/2/4 children (candidate build harness); build/2 is paired with the original serial build.
idNotes.build/final: One clean build with the final build script; dist names/bytes/modes identical to the serial build.
idNotes.pack-results: Initial three ten-package pack pairs, before shared-helper extraction.
idNotes.final-pack-results: One ten-package pack pair on the final packing source.
idNotes.nix-pack-results: Three pairs of the exact eight-package Nix install-phase pack.
idNotes.pack-real: Legacy baseline-only pack probe; no candidate pair.
idNotes.edit-exact|edit-diff: Timed on the first edit-diff revision; the final follow-up changed only the fuzzy offset mapping, which these exact-match workloads do not reach.
idNotes.edit-fuzzy: Timed on the final edit-diff revision.

qualification.description: Matched before/after timing of isolated startup, native Bash spill, Biome and the first-comparison controls selected for rerun. Values are rounded to 6 significant digits; summaries come from unrounded values. Negative medianChangePercent means less time.

method.order: Each case ran in 8 serial fresh processes: before, after, after, before, before, after, after, before (four rotations; the root that runs first alternates).
method.processValue: raw: median of the process's emitted samples. single: the process's one logged operation or logged average. summary: the process's logged median over its internal runs (internal samples not emitted).
method.summary: median, min and max of the four process values per root.
method.result: slower or faster only when all four rotation pairs move the same way and the two roots' process ranges do not overlap; otherwise no clear change.
method.notUsed: The runner's outer process elapsedMs (import, setup, hashing and cleanup) is not used.

sampleKinds.raw: rawValues lists every emitted sample per process. AI (ms/op) and Codex (ms/pair) samples are each an average over that sample's operations.
sampleKinds.single: One value per process: one operation (Bash, Biome) or one logged average over the fixture's repetitions (TUI ms/op, history µs/read).
sampleKinds.summary: One logged per-process median; the internal samples were not emitted and cannot be recovered.
sampleKinds.instrumentation: Deterministic byte count, not a latency.

environment.lane: Serial runner, one child at a time, on a shared non-idle workstation. No attempt was discarded or retried.

before.description: Baseline checkout: tracked product sources and the ten built dist trees match the baseline build. It also carries the candidate's build and pack scripts, which no qualification case executes.

after.description: First-comparison candidate plus the prompt-cache accounting change (core/cache-stats.ts, settings-selector.ts, interactive-mode.ts within the runner's source scope), with a fresh offline build and release daemon.

roots.sourceScope: run.mjs hashes packages/*/src, the Env daemon src/manifests, non-performance scripts, lock and tsconfig files, package manifests and three coding-agent test helpers. Files outside that scope are not identified here. Hydrated provider JSON and its manifest are identical in both roots.

qualification.unmeasuredLaterChanges: Neither comparison timed changes made after the qualified after tree, including the Cloudflare prompt-cache capability policy, the native cache-warmer retention fix and the refreshed model catalog. Both comparisons used the catalog with modelCatalogManifestSha256 above.

runner.note: Paths are relative to scripts/performance/. The listed files received the qualification selectors and three fixture-only smoke repairs before timing; no file changed during timing.

bash.note: Every process wrote the exact payload; display, truncation and structured-result witnesses are equal across roots. Stream close is not fsync.

biome.payload: Clean detached checkout of the baseline commit, shared by both roots through --artifact-repo.
biome.note: gitInventoryFiles counts Git's tracked plus untracked-unignored paths and the Biome configuration files hashed by the fixture; it is not Biome's scanned-file count. The witness is the wrapper's exit status.

smokeAttempts.failed: sessions-branch-20 before: exit 1, prepareCompaction returned nothing for the 20-entry smoke input
smokeAttempts.repair: Smoke-only compaction budget keepRecentTokens 1; the full 100,000-entry budget stays 200.

smokeAttempts.failed: sessions-boundary-20 after: witness mismatch; the faux provider's input/totalTokens estimates include generated fixture paths
smokeAttempts.repair: Boundary witness omits durationMs and only the faux input/totalTokens fields; raw faux usage is logged.

smokeAttempts.failed: ls-10000 before: exit 1, the baseline ls result has no details object for an untruncated listing
smokeAttempts.repair: ls verification treats details as optional when no entry limit is reached.

limits: The faux provider reports zero cache usage; these runs make no prompt-cache hit claim.
Startup witnesses record only a successful get_state response.
The session listAll witness excludes activity-clock ordering, which owner tests cover.
The AI queue witness is an aggregate, not a FIFO-order proof.
spill-64mib is the synchronous OutputAccumulator push path, not the Bash tool.
Biome witnesses the wrapper exit status, not a diagnostics transcript.
